Subject: Red-team eval funding pathway for head-to-head RFP

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for taking a look at our RFP. BluePeak Labs is running a red-team style, head-to-head benchmark against three vendors as part of a larger procurement this fall. We attached the RFP and a short evaluation rubric.

Quick context: the bake-off will focus on safety edge cases, latency under load, and upsampled conversational quality for 8-10k token contexts. We expect a 3-week active evaluation window with a follow-on POC request.

Ask: would Redwood consider a pilot sponsorship — an evaluation credit package plus a 2-week trial extension — to participate competitively? We are especially interested in:
- Dedicated support during initial setup
- A short SLA for endpoint availability during the active window
- A pass/fail gating on safety regressions (we can share a small labeled prompt set)

Attached: bluepeak-rfp.pdf

If you are open, can we aim to have an approved funding pathway by next Tuesday? Happy to set a 30-min sync.

Best,
Samir Patel
Head of Platform Partnerships
BluePeak Labs
From: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@bluepeak.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Red-team eval funding pathway for head-to-head RFP

Samir,

Appreciate the detail and the rubric — good framing. We are open to sponsoring the evaluation, with conditions. Early thoughts:

- Proposed package: 50k inference credits (covers roughly 180-220 GPU hours depending on model family) + 25k embedding units for up-front vectorization testing.
- Trial extension: full access for an additional 14 days beyond the standard sandbox window.
- Support: one dedicated solutions engineer during onboarding, and a single runbook for the red-team prompts.

Conditions we need:
1) Limited public benchmarking until mutual consent (embargo 30 days after final results).
2) Token and model usage capped to the package unless pre-authorized.
3) Access restricted to named BluePeak engineers for the evaluation window.

If that sounds close, I will route for internal approval with proposed conditional terms and a short agreement. Can you send the procurement contact and any billing PO details?

I can do a quick sync Monday morning if that helps.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Marissa, Laura — can you confirm we can grant the voucher under these guardrails? If yes, Karthik will finalize the short agreement and we can attach a negotiated draft.
